episodes.synopsis: A story about spies and scientists. A boy is abandoned in Leo's jungle when his grandfather is kidnapped.
episodes.title: The First Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Leo gets the animals to report the dangers they encounter so that others may learn to avoid them.
episodes.title: The Map of Danger

episodes.synopsis: Leo learns the reason a blue lion is so antagonistic.
episodes.title: The Blue Lion

episodes.synopsis: A hunt for Leo results in him being temporarily blinded.
episodes.title: The Last Hunt of the Ahabi People

episodes.synopsis: Rune and Rukio are born to Leo and Lea. The best episode so far, as Leo decides that Rune needs some help to be up to the life that awaits him.
episodes.title: Leo Becomes a Father

episodes.synopsis: A peaceful band of gorillas, dependent on a giant for their safety, seek a new home.
episodes.title: The Mighty Gorilla

episodes.synopsis: Two people, a father and son, are the last survivors of their tribe. Because they possess a golden bow, they are pursued throughout Africa.
episodes.title: The Golden Bow

episodes.synopsis: The powerful moonstones are the quest in this spoof of James Bond movies.
episodes.title: The Case of The Moonlight Stone

episodes.synopsis: A threatening flock of falcons invades Leo's jungle.
episodes.title: The Falcons

episodes.synopsis: An enemy of Leo's befriends Rune and Rukio.
episodes.title: Rick the Lycon

episodes.synopsis: Rune thinks he is protecting it when he places Panja's hide in a tree. It is spotted by men in a helicopter who take it to a city. The white lion skin is swapped about through lies and corruption while Leo and Rune try to get it back.
episodes.title: Panja's Hide

episodes.synopsis: One of the strongest episodes of the entire Leo series, dealing powerfully with the harm done by poaching.
episodes.title: The Poachers

episodes.synopsis: Leo becomes involved in a bizarre revenge match between a blind man and a leopard.
episodes.title: Duel at Lubar Valley

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious mammoth reveals that other prehistoric creatures still exist as well.
episodes.title: The Saber-Toothed Tiger

episodes.synopsis: A giraffe has strange markings which make it an outcast from its herd, and desired by hunters.
episodes.title: The Marked Giraffe

episodes.synopsis: The trauma of a plane crash causes a woman's pet leopard to go wild.
episodes.title: Lily the Black Leopard

episodes.synopsis: Leo reluctantly aids Totto (Cassius) the panther who, at the first opportunity, tries to kill Rune and Rukio. Leo's rage is so great that he inadvertently hurts Mandy (Dan'l).
episodes.title: Devil Falls

episodes.synopsis: The obnoxious elephant, Bizo, must cooperate with Rune or both of them will die!
episodes.title: The Steel Monster

episodes.synopsis: Rune gets the idea to build a stone castle as protection against disasters like fire.
episodes.title: A House for the Animals

episodes.synopsis: The surrounding area is engulfed in an advancing flood. Leo finds that the cause of the flood is a new dam.
episodes.title: The White Cliff

episodes.synopsis: The hyenas, under an enormous Godfather-like leader, trap Leo into helping with a deadly plan.
episodes.title: Agura the Terrible

episodes.synopsis: Thousands of hungry and thirsty elephants approach Leo's jungle. The resident herd of elephants does not want to allow them to live there.
episodes.title: Candle Rock

episodes.synopsis: A plane transporting Russian wolves crashes in the jungle. The wolves take Rukio prisoner as they try to find a way to survive.
episodes.title: The Silver Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Rune and Rukio help a blind buffalo.
episodes.title: Adventure at Volcano Island

episodes.synopsis: A spotted fever plague sweeps through the jungle, affecting most of the animals.
episodes.title: The Green Plague

episodes.synopsis: Leo accompanies an expedition to Mt. Moon to search for the moonlight stones, which can solve the world's energy shortage.
episodes.title: The Eternal Mount Moon
